definitions.explanation: A piece used in board games such as shogi (Japanese chess), chess, or go.
Figuratively, a person used by others for their own purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駒|こま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駒|こま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Shogi pieces are made of wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駒|こま}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: He was being used as a pawn by his boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{駒|こま}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}われる→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the world of politics, people are sometimes treated like pawns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一人|ひとり}ひとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{駒|こま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In a large organization, one can sometimes feel like nothing more than a pawn.

notes:
SHOGI PIECES ({将棋|しょうぎ}の{駒|こま}):
- {王将|おうしょう}/{玉将|ぎょくしょう} (king)
- {飛車|ひしゃ} (rook)
- {角行|かくぎょう} (bishop)
- {金将|きんしょう} (gold general)
- {銀将|ぎんしょう} (silver general)
- {桂馬|けいま} (knight)
- {香車|きょうしゃ} (lance)
- {歩兵|ふひょう} (pawn)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {駒|こま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ (to advance a piece; to make progress)
- {駒|こま}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use someone as a pawn)
- {持|も}ち{駒|ごま} (pieces in hand - captured pieces in shogi; also figuratively: resources at one's disposal)

NOTE: The word {駒|こま} originally meant 'horse' and is sometimes still used in this archaic sense in literary contexts.

OTHER MEANING:
- ⟦{独楽|こま}→独楽：10104_koma⟧ (spinning top) - written with different kanji but same pronunciation
